note: UA-Soroban op vectors (spec §2, §10; plan SOR-D12), generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/soroban-ua-ops-vectors.mjs. digest = sha256(xdr(Vec[Symbol("scaas_metaop_v1"), Bytes(networkId), Address(contract), Symbol(fn), Vec(args)])), args without auth, each arg a hex ScVal XDR (Option None = Void, Some(v) = v; a contracttype struct = Map of Symbol(field) sorted; a contracttype enum = Vec[Symbol(variant), payload]). uaMsg = keccak256(MSG_TAG | TAG(kind) | purposeTag | digest); auth: the kind's signature over uaMsg (ML-DSA over pq_msg = keccak256(TAG(kind) | uaMsg), empty context; WebAuthn the canonical abi.encode blob); msig: abi.encode(MemberSig[]) of members 0 and 1 over memberDigest(ua, uaMsg) under purpose member, empty keyData (registered members). The args name the signer (from / ua / order.maker), so args and digest are per kind. ua_order is ua_trade's digest (contract = token, fn "ua_order", args (dex, order)); ua_cancel the DEX's (SOR-D10); ua_relay the inner token.ua_pay of router.ua_relay (relayer = Some(router), pay_ref = relay.ref = keccak256("scaas.relayfee" | networkId | xdr(target) | keccak256(xdr((func, args))) | salt), open mode: to = router); mtx_* are signed by the mandate owner (mtx_set_mandate) and the delegate (mtx_mandate_pay). registrations[i] = register(kind, keyData, empty attrs, pop, empty pqz_pop, None) (portable, no network); the single-key rows are portable.json's; mldsa65 signs as mldsa65#2, mldsa65#1 is an msig member.
